title: The bottleneck map: what each surviving explanation can claim
nature: a reading of the record, not new evidence

vocabulary.rule: the scope is part of the status; where the evidence splits, a compound status is required
labels: demonstrated constraint on coverage; effect on behavior untested
vocabulary.label_rule: A row may carry only a label in vocabulary.labels; every label there must have an entry in label_meanings; a new label is added to both in the same change, never invented in a row.

rows.label: weakened
rows.check: all 112 true world edges were present in memory on the tested worlds, so a shortage of candidates is ruled out there as the constraint on coverage
rows.does_not_say: that candidates are always available. This is presence of the world's edges in one world family, not availability in general
rows.would_change: a world family where some true edges never enter memory

rows.label: unresolved
rows.check: the candidate space was characterized but no generator was intervened on: the measured defect is its ordering, not the presence of the edges
rows.does_not_say: that a different generation strategy cannot help. Nothing that changes which pairs a generator proposes was tested
rows.would_change: a generation rule that changes which pairs enter, scored at a fixed budget

rows.label: demonstrated constraint on coverage; effect on behavior untested
rows.check: under the engine's own global count-ranked selection the 112 world edges are spread, not clustered: the top 20 recovers 0-1, the top 40 0-2, the top 80 8-16, the top 160 36-55 and the top 320 (about 16x the budget) 106-109; precision never exceeds 0.3438 across 36 measurements under two allocation rules
rows.does_not_say: that fixing selection fixes behavior. No cell has shown a downstream gain from a better-ranked selection, which is why the first status is scoped to coverage and the second is not established
rows.would_change: the density study's treatment arm, if the treated ranking moves a behavioral endpoint

rows.label: unresolved
rows.check: Phase L measured structural displacement, and DI/PI are retention indices; its verdict stands at H3-L - INCONCLUSIVE. The capacity-1,000 confirmatory test found no improvement on held-out prediction, with its interval crossing zero
rows.does_not_say: that structure fails to transfer. Retention was measured; usability of what is retained was not
rows.would_change: a study that scores behavior from carried structure instead of retention of that structure

rows.label: supported concern
rows.check: the architecture's own motivational mechanisms were disabled one at a time and scored on the predicted direction: three of five predictions reversed, including contradiction's weight and question generation
rows.does_not_say: that the theory is refuted, or that these reversals cause any downstream failure. The concern is supported; the causal link is not
rows.would_change: a mechanism whose predicted direction holds under a matched ablation

rows.label: supported at the sparse end
rows.check: A2 ran all 640 registered cells: the sparse-end precision level was 0.059 (95 percent interval 0.041 to 0.078) against a bar of 0.05, thirteen of sixteen seeds positive, and the dense-minus-sparse difference was 0.091 (0.072 to 0.109) under both exposure schemes
rows.does_not_say: that density matters for behaviour, or that the slope is evidence: the slope is reported descriptively, the dense end is pinned by the pool's composition at 0.150, and no cell measures a downstream gain
rows.would_change: a different world family or candidate space: the result licenses an allocation change on this layer only

rows.label: not supported
rows.check: the paired-capacity records found no pool-structure moderation; this artifact does not restate their numbers, and the status is the owner's reading of them
rows.does_not_say: that pool structure is refuted. No support in the conditions tested is not evidence of absence
rows.would_change: a test that manipulates pool structure independently of size and scale

rows.label: not supported
rows.check: the ratio- and temporal-redundancy preregistrations and their block records tested redundancy as a moderator; this artifact does not restate their numbers, and the status is the owner's reading of them
rows.would_change: a world where redundancy varies while pool and scale are held fixed

rows.label: unresolved
rows.check: two points of the parameter range: 0.95 fails the harness liveness criterion on the matrix stream and horizon, while 1.0 passes it through cycle 2,999 (owner-reported)
rows.does_not_say: that decay is unnecessary, or that decay is necessary. Neither direction was tested
rows.would_change: the matched decay-on/off comparison that estimates the parameter's effect with everything else held fixed

constraint_ledger.purpose: The constraint ledger, not a second explanation map: the constraints under consideration, at most one in test, each with its evidence, a causal hypothesis, a single-variable intervention, and the rule that retires the hypothesis.
constraint_ledger.retirement_rule: A row is retired after its intervention returns a pass, fail or inconclusive result and the corresponding architectural decision is recorded, or after it is recorded as attempt_invalid: a VOID block and a registration withdrawn before a grant both mean no admissible comparison exists, so the result must mark the hypothesis untested, must record cells_started, and the decision must say so - and, when cells_started is 0, that it is not refuted. Another benchmark family, another explanation, or another document does not retire a row.
constraint_ledger.policy: At most one row may be in test; zero is valid before the first test and after the active row retires. K2 retired as an invalid attempt in which its block ran and returned VOID; K1 retired as an invalid attempt in which no cell was opened, because its endpoint could not produce an admissible comparison. No K1 or K2 cell ran under either registration. The successor row K1S entered test on 2026-11-20 under a dated owner grant at floor 35; no cell has run on it.

amendments.change: A retirement may cite a result whose outcome is attempt_invalid, provided the result records hypothesis_status untested and criteria_read false and the decision says the hypothesis is untested.
amendments.because: K2's one block was VOID on G4 by construction; no criterion was read. A VOID is not a null result, so the row may leave in-test without being described as a refuted hypothesis.
amendments.scope: This adds a terminal disposition, not a pass/fail outcome; pass, fail and inconclusive keep their existing meaning.

amendments.change: Every attempt_invalid retirement must cite a result that records cells_started, an integer count of the cells the attempt started. A result whose cells_started is 0 records a registration withdrawn before a grant - no cell ran because the registration was found unable to produce an admissible comparison. Such a result must record hypothesis_status untested and criteria_read false, and its decision must say both that the hypothesis is untested and that it is not refuted.
amendments.because: K1's registered endpoint asserts all eighteen gold pairs on every seed, so recall is at its ceiling and its intervention can only add false assertions. That is the same category as a VOID block - no admissible comparison exists - discovered one step earlier, and it must not be recorded as a refutation or as a null result.
amendments.scope: This widens which attempt_invalid results a retirement may cite, not what attempt_invalid means: no admissible comparison exists. The field is required on every such result, so the unrun branch cannot be dodged by omitting it; cells_started 0 distinguishes a withdrawal from a block that ran and returned VOID (K2 records 20). Nothing here is a pass, fail or inconclusive outcome.

rows.evidence: Organica 0.4111 vs strongest baseline 0.9846; difference -0.5735 [-0.6162, -0.5309]; 10/10 per-seed differences negative; NO_FALSIFICATION +0.0241 [-0.0048, +0.0495]
rows.hypothesis: Pre-boundary associations retain priority after the revision boundary, so new evidence cannot displace them.
rows.intervention: Lower the retention priority of pre-switch associations after the boundary, with the same seeds and the strongest baseline unchanged.
rows.decision_rule: PASS: K2 paired difference improves by at least 0.10 while K1's absolute change is at most 0.05. FAIL: K2 improves by less than 0.05, or K1's absolute change is more than 0.05. INCONCLUSIVE: K2 improvement is between 0.05 and 0.10, or the audit/validity condition fails.
rows.retirement_reason: The one block was VOID on G4_no_pre_boundary_demotions; no criterion was read, so the hypothesis is untested, not refuted, and no second block is authorised.

rows.evidence: Organica 0.0000 vs strongest baseline 0.8578; difference -0.8578; 10/10 per-seed differences negative; late-incorporation F1 0.000 on all seeds; NO_DREAMS 0.0 [0.0, 0.0]
rows.hypothesis: Late structure never reaches the service path, so integration is not measurable.
rows.intervention: Force late structure into the service path and measure service utilization before reading the endpoint.
rows.decision_rule: If service is nonzero but K3 remains 0.0, retire the service-path hypothesis. If service is zero, the intervention did not occur and the row stays open.

rows.evidence: 0.9.0: Organica 0.5923 vs strongest baseline 0.9360; difference -0.3437 [-0.3773, -0.3123]. 0.15.0 same-build replication: Organica 0.3120 vs baseline 0.9360; difference -0.623961 [-0.646675, -0.599907]; 10/10 per-seed differences negative; NO_QUESTIONS -0.0095 [-0.0328, +0.0140].
rows.hypothesis: Incremental updates are not selected into the served path.
rows.intervention: Force incremental updates into the served set, in-process, with no frozen-engine edit; same ten K1 seeds and the strongest-of-grid baseline.
rows.decision_rule: PASS: K1 paired difference improves by at least 0.10 relative to the 0.15.0 same-build gap of -0.623961, with K2 and K3 changing by no more than 0.05 absolute. FAIL: K1 improves by less than 0.05, or a guard family changes by more than 0.05 absolute. INCONCLUSIVE: K1 improvement is between 0.05 and 0.10, or the audit/validity condition fails. No cell may run without a dated owner grant.
rows.retirement_reason: The 0.15.0 replication asserts all eighteen gold pairs on every seed (recall 1.000 on all ten, false negatives zero) and the late group is present rather than absent, so the deficit the hypothesis names is not the one the shipped build has; the loss is carried by false assertions and the registered intervention can only add them. Withdrawn before a grant: no cell started, the hypothesis is untested, not refuted.

rows.evidence: All three matched-ablation intervals contain zero; the frozen mechanism_implicated field is inverted and the code fix and erratum are recorded.
rows.hypothesis: Either the tested mechanisms are not load-bearing, or the endpoint cannot isolate them.
rows.intervention: Add a positive-control arm whose effect the endpoint is known to detect before interpreting another zero interval.
rows.decision_rule: If the positive control does not move the endpoint, retire the row as a measurement defect and do not claim that no mechanism is load-bearing.

rows.evidence: K1 retired as an invalid attempt (cells_started 0). 0.15.0 same-build replication: Organica 0.3120 vs strongest-of-grid 0.9360; difference -0.623961 [-0.646675, -0.599907]; 10/10 per-seed differences negative. Preflight 2026-11-19 on the ten K1 seeds: 120 unordered temporal pairs, 24 carrying within-event co-occurrence; F* = 44, M_s(F*) 18-21. NOT A RESULT.
rows.hypothesis: The K1 deficit is candidate admission, not pair content: the served-path rules keep false pairs and drop gold ones, and admitting strictly by within-event support at a high floor serves all eighteen gold pairs with few decoys.
rows.intervention: Engine 0.16.0: _build_predictions admits a temporal pair when its co-occurrence count is at least the granted floor F, serves one ranked list, no partition or backfill, no frozen-engine edit.
rows.decision_rule: PASS: the K1 paired difference improves by at least 0.10 relative to -0.623961 while the K2 and K3 paired differences change by no more than 0.05 absolute. FAIL: less than 0.05, or a guard family changes by more than 0.05. INCONCLUSIVE: between 0.05 and 0.10, or the audit/validity condition fails.

corrections.why: 'not supported' reads as a tested hypothesis found against. What ran was two points of the parameter range on one stream and horizon; necessity was never tested

corrections.now: demonstrated constraint on coverage; effect on behavior untested
corrections.why: the demonstrated result is that frequency ranking cannot surface the world's edges at the engine's budget. No cell shows that a better-ranked selection improves a behavioral endpoint, so the second half stays unestablished

specified_experiment.note: the only row with a registered block, and it has run: A2 executed 320 judged cells plus 320 exposure-check cells on sixteen fresh seeds and returned the positive branch of its own decision table; A1 is held and unrun

provenance.source: the owner's map, 2026-11-07, with two rows corrected in the same exchange

tags.ARTIFACT_READ: the status was checked, for this record, against the records named in the row's evidence
tags.OWNER_READING: the status is the owner's reading of the named records, which this record does not restate, and the check quotes no figure from them
tags.AGENT_INFERRED: an agent inferred the status; no reading was made for this record, and it cannot carry a supported status
tags.PROTOCOL_CONSTRAINT: the value is fixed by a registration rather than measured, so the tag must name the registration

provenance.rule: every row carries exactly one tag, and the tag is checked rather than described: a tag the row's evidence cannot back is refused, a row may not quote a figure without claiming the reading that produced it, an inference may not carry a supported status, and a protocol-fixed value must name its registration
provenance.owner_reading_note: the named records are where a reader checks these statuses; this artifact restates none of their numbers
provenance.status_rule: a status added here needs a check behind it, not a story

not: a likelihood ranking: statuses are not probabilities and the rows are not ordered by promise
a re-scoring of H3-L, of the 448-cell calibration null, or of any Phase K result
an allocation: no seed, cell, threshold or bar is spent here
a replacement for the records it points at; when they change, this map is re-read against them

weakened.means: evidence bears against the explanation as the dominant one, within the tested scope
weakened.mapping_note: Narrowed when candidate availability was split from candidate-generation strategy: the unresolved half of that claim now sits in its own row, so this label describes the supported half only.

demonstrated constraint on coverage; eff.means: evidence supports a limit within the tested scope, and the wider effect was not measured
demonstrated constraint on coverage; eff.status: Supported within the tested scope + Not established / not measured

supported concern.means: a prediction the explanation makes failed, so the concern is real

not supported.means: a tested prediction did not materialize, or the evidence did not appear where it would have
not supported.gap: the four-status vocabulary has no separate 'tested and not supported' category. The closest, 'not established / not measured', means the record cannot decide, which is wrong for a test that ran and returned nothing. This label is the map's, and the gap is recorded here rather than absorbed

unresolved.means: the record cannot decide the question

supported at the sparse end.means: the block ran, every gate passed and its pre-registered criterion was met whole, on one world family and one cap

split_rule: a row splits when the claim differs, and keeps a compound status when one claim is measured on two endpoints
